class.name: PuertsNodejsBackend
class.brief_description: Creates ECMAScript runtimes backed by Node.js.
class.description: Pass an instance to [method PuertsEnvironment.initialize] to select Node.js. Call [method PuertsEnvironment.tick] regularly to advance backend work. Supports inspector debugging, low-memory notification, and execution termination. Use either Node.js or V8 in a process; loading both can cause conflicts.

method.name: _puerts_get_functions_ptr
method.description: Internal interface used by [method PuertsEnvironment.initialize] to obtain the backend function table.
